definitions.full: H4187. Mushi or Mushshi I. מֻשִׁי מוּשִׁי, proper name, masculine a Levite, son of Merari , מוּשִׁי Exod 6:19 ; Num 3:20 ; 1Chr 6:32 ; 23:21 , 23 ; 24:26 , 30 ; מֻשִׁי 6:4 ; ᵐ5 Ομονς ( ε ) ι , rarely Μονς ( ε ) ι , Μοονσι

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi.
Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
